assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
Atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.91
Transient ischemic attacks is coded as G45.9
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events and to optimize rate control and anticoagulation management
The appeal directly addresses the clinical necessity denied under PR-204
